_note: Power-chord voicing engine settings (docs/power-chord-engine-brief.md §5). Tune the weights here, never in code. Lower cost = better. Owner decisions: fret limit 12 for chords (DECISIONS.md).
_rareShapes: Shapes a rhythm part must never use: the D-root 3-note shape puts its octave on the B string (e.g. D6 G8 B9), which reads and sounds wrong to most guitarists (owner call, 2026-09-27). D-root 2-note shapes stay available as a last resort (the dRoot weight).

zone._note: A section's zone runs from `below` frets under its target position to `above` frets over it (a 5-6 fret hand zone).

alternatives._note: Regenerate picks among paths whose cost is within `margin` of the best (seed 0 is always the best path).
